name: phglabs-play-reel
description: Instagram Reel for play.phglabs.in, rendered with TwinStudio local tools. node_modules is a junction to ../reel/node_modules.

scripts.mux: C:/hari/code/twin-souls-studio/tools/ffmpeg/ffmpeg.exe -y -loglevel error -i build/video.mp4 -i build/mix.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/phglabs-play-reel.mp4
scripts.build: npm run timeline && npm run render && npm run audio && npm run mux
scripts.all: npm run voice && npm run words && npm run capture && npm run build
